doc.title: Howie Shear interviewed by Monk Rowe, Dunkirk, New York, October 11, 2014

chapter: Joan Rivers Show and Woody Herman
title: Working on the Joan Rivers Show
summary: Joan Rivers was wonderful to work for; Shear wrote 98 percent of the music for an 18-piece band, but the show lasted only a year.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: What was she like to work for?
She was wonderful. She was wonderful. Unfortunately it only lasted a year. It should have still been on, at this point it would have been on over 30 years.

Yeah. It was like an 18-piece big band. And I got to write — oh I wrote 98% of the material. Nothing prerecorded. Played everything live, and it was live to everywhere in the country except in L.A. where they prerecorded it. So I got to play on the show, then I went home and watched it, to see if I could have improved something or other.
It was kind of a fun gig. But she was a great, great, great person to work for.
